note: Honduras: nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for 90 days (Taiwan 3 months, the Dominican Republic 60), extendable by 30; British citizens need a visa since 15 August 2024; everyone else needs a visa (holders of Schengen, Canadian or US visas may enter: not modelled).
